sql: /* Query 2: filter1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT manager.age, team.founded_year, player.name, city.city_name FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.birth_date = '1994/2/2'

age.description: age is the age of the team owner, a integer (e.g. 45).

founded_year.description: founded_year is the year of this team team founded (e.g. 1947).

name.description: full name of the NBA player (e.g., LeBron James).

city_name.description: city_name is the name of the city (e.g. Boston)
